note: The offense play designs (designed, not fitted; docs/specs/m3-playbook-and-custom-routes.md, milestone A). Each design belongs to one engine call, a formation and a concept, and gives one assignment per player by library id (data/plays/library.json). An assignment is an id, or { use, to, depth, primary }: `to` is the side (left or right, from the offense) a side-axis entry goes to, `depth` moves a route's break to that many yards past the line, `primary` marks the first read. Linemen not listed take the concept's line block (data/plays/config.json), or the design's `line`. `side` is the play side against the formation's strong side. Exactly one design per engine call is the default. aiWeight is the weight a computer coach gives the design inside its engine call. Nothing here has an engine effect yet.
